title: Make the brief's sign-up link lead to the trial sign-up, and link the trial from the docs
reach_basis: Every signup passes the sign-up step: 400 signups a quarter (the PRD's assumption); people lost at the dead link are not counted, so this is a floor
evidence_detail: Step 1: portal.qrypt.com/register is a 404; /trial is linked only from the login page

title: One API and one name in the portal: show the documented GET example beside a new key, and call it a token in the portal, the docs and the errors
reach_basis: Everyone who creates a token sees the example: 80% of 400 signups a quarter (the PRD's assumption), the PRD's stage 2 target
evidence_detail: Steps 5 and 6: the portal's example is POST eaas-aws with X-API-Key, which the docs never name and which closed the connection unanswered; the portal says API key, the docs token

title: Fix Qrypt's own code examples: send the Accept header, check the status before the body, read the token from the environment, never print the entropy
reach_basis: Half of the 320 token holders read Qrypt's reference examples rather than the quickstart (assumed)
evidence_detail: DQ-01 to DQ-03: three of four examples leave out Accept, none checks the status, the Python one hard-codes the token and prints every byte

title: Put the temporary password on a line of its own in the trial email, or send a one-time link instead
reach_basis: Every trial signup gets the email: 400 signups a quarter (the PRD's assumption)
evidence_detail: Step 3: the password ends in a period inside a sentence, so a reader cannot tell which periods belong to it

title: Publish an llms.txt at docs.qrypt.com, as a pull request built from this project's
reach_basis: Half of the 320 token holders work with an AI coding agent (assumed)
evidence_detail: DQ-05: docs.qrypt.com/llms.txt is a 404; with this project's version, Claude Code succeeded 15 of 15

title: Answer a bad token with the documented 401, or at least a body of its own
reach_basis: One in five of the 320 token holders sends a wrong token at least once (assumed)
evidence_detail: Live: a wrong token gets 403 Forbidden or entropy quota reached, the answer to a used-up allotment; the docs say 401

title: Run the agent test with other agents and a smaller model
reach_basis: The same 160 token holders who work with an AI agent (assumed)
evidence_detail: Only Claude Code has run; the harness takes another agent's command with --agent-command

title: Document Cloudflare's error 1010 for a library's default User-Agent in Qrypt's docs, or let such requests through
reach_basis: One in ten of the 320 token holders writes a client that sends a library's default User-Agent (assumed)
evidence_detail: Live: Python's default Python-urllib/3.x got Cloudflare's 403 Error 1010 before the token was read

title: Document a trial key's real rate limit, and send Retry-After with a 429
reach_basis: A quarter of the 200 activated accounts (50% of signups, the PRD's target) send requests closer than 1.5 s apart (assumed)
evidence_detail: Live: a 429 at 0.36 s after a 200, no Retry-After, every 429 cleared within 1.5 s; the docs say 30 requests in 10 s

title: Say the remaining allotment in every answer, as a response header
reach_basis: Half of the 200 activated accounts return within 7 days, the PRD's stage 5 target
evidence_detail: Teardown: RANDOM.ORG's bitsLeft lets a client see its budget before it runs out; Qrypt's first sign is a 403
